out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: pastries in display case without time markings.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC added time markings during inspection.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Window or door is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means. Observed sliding window without screen open at expo.
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. PIC closed window during inspection.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: observed cream containers, strainer stored next to hand sink at expo.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. PIC relocated food equipment to storage area.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: observed raw beef stored above raw shell egg in 2 door prep.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EHS conducted education regarding raw storage. Employee placed all raw items in unit on bottom shelf.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed strawberry cheese danish (60F) in display case at front counter.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS instructed PIC to discard item after 2 hours. In the future, this item will be placed on time as a public health control.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths stored directly 2 dr prep counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer bucket with appropriate chlorine concentration.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Ham (45F), Chicken (46F) - in Turbo-Air Prep Refrg. Unsalted Butter (47F), Milk X3( 45F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All food items were moved to freezer to blast chill. Ham was observed at 41F during inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: AVANTCO 2-DR UPRIGHT REFRG. - 50F
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO REPAIR THE REFRIGERATOR UNIT AND PROVIDE A SERVICE RECEIPT WITHIN 7 DAYS. THE OPERATOR IS ADVISED TO USE THE OTHER REFRIGERATOR UNITS THAT ARE CAPABLE OF HOLDING 41F OR BELOW UNTIL THIS UNIT IS REPAIRED.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: THE FOLLOWING ITEMS WERE OBSERVED ARE NOT NSF OR EQUIVALENT: - MIXTURE AT THE FRONT SERVICE AREA - MIXTURE AT THE BACK PREP AREA
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO PROVIDE SPECIFICATION SHEET FOR REVIEW PRIOR TO BUYING A NEW ONE. THE MIXTURE AT THE FRONT SERVICE WAS REMOVED FROM THE FACILITY. THE OPERATOR WILL CONTACT EHS FOR FURTHER CONSULTATION IF NEEDED.
